about: The licence of every agent skill pinned in skills-lock.json, checked against toolbox/policy.json ('allow'). A source repo can mix licences (anthropics/skills does: each skill carries its own LICENSE.txt), so the record is per skill. tests/run.py fails when a pinned skill has no entry here or its licence is not allowed.

calesthio/generative-media-skills.evidence: repo licence (GitHub API), checked 2026-10-09; the 14 pinned production skills read for downloads, keys and agent-directed text before pinning

frontend-design.evidence: skills/frontend-design/LICENSE.txt in anthropics/skills (the repo has no single licence), checked 2026-10-09
